video.title: Board of Trustees of the Affordable Housing Trust (AHT) 6/18/26

summary.headline: The Affordable Housing Trust voted to enter executive session to discuss a potential property acquisition and did not return to open session.
summary.summary: The Southborough Affordable Housing Trust convened briefly on June 18, 2024. The trustees voted unanimously by roll call to enter executive session to discuss potential property acquisition under Massachusetts General Law Chapter 30A, Section 21(a)(6). The board stated it had no intention to return to open session, ending the public broadcast.

topics.title: Vote to enter executive session for property acquisition
topics.summary: The chair moved to enter executive session under MGL Chapter 30A, Section 21(a)(6) to discuss a potential real estate acquisition. The chair determined that an open discussion would have a detrimental effect on the town's negotiating position. The board voted by roll call to enter executive session and did not return to open session.
key_details: Invoked Massachusetts General Law Chapter 30A, Section 21(a)(6) for property acquisition
Chair stated open session would compromise the town's negotiating position
Trustees had no intention to return to open session
Approved unanimously by roll call vote
topics.outcome: Approved entering executive session with no return to open session

votes.motion: Enter executive session under MGL Chapter 30A, Section 21 to discuss potential property acquisition with no intent to return to open session

summary.caveats: The board went directly into executive session and did not reconvene in open session, so no substantive public discussions were held on the recording.
